const DNS_TYPE_NAMES = Dict(1=>"A",2=>"NS",5=>"CNAME",6=>"SOA",12=>"PTR",15=>"MX",16=>"TXT",28=>"AAAA")
const RCODE_NAMES = ("NoError","FormErr","ServFail","NXDomain","NotImp","Refused")
type_name(type) = get(DNS_TYPE_NAMES,type,"TYPE$type")
class_name(class) = class == 1 ? "IN" : "CLASS$class"
rcode_name(code) = code < length(RCODE_NAMES) ? RCODE_NAMES[code+1] : "RCODE$code"
function dns_chunk(message,position,size)
    position+size > length(message) && throw(Malformed("dns: truncated"))
    message[(position+1):(position+size)]
end
dns_byte(message,position) = Int(only(dns_chunk(message,position,1)))
dns_integer(message,position,size) = read_integer(dns_chunk(message,position,size),0,size)
function dns_label(label)
    join(33 <= byte <= 126 && !(byte in (
        46,
        92
    )) ? string(Char(byte)) : "\\$(lpad(string(Int(byte)),3,'0'))" for byte in label)
end
function dns_name(message,position)
    labels = String[]
    pointers = 0
    after = nothing
    while true
        size = dns_byte(message,position)
        if size == 0
            isnothing(after) && (after=position+1)
            break
        elseif size >= 192
            low = dns_byte(message,position+1)
            isnothing(after) && (after=position+2)
            pointers += 1
            pointers > 16 && throw(Malformed("dns: compression loop"))
            target = (size-192)*256+low
            target >= length(message) && throw(Malformed("dns: pointer out of range"))
            position = target
        elseif size >= 64
            throw(Malformed("dns: bad label type"))
        else
            push!(labels,dns_label(dns_chunk(message,position+1,size)))
            position += size+1
        end
    end
    return (isempty(labels) ? "<root>" : join(labels,'.'), after)
end
function ipv6_notation(address)
    groups = [read_integer(address,i,2) for i in 0:2:14]
    best_start,best_length,index = 0,1,1
    while index <= length(groups)
        if groups[index] != 0
            index += 1
            continue
        end
        stop = index
        while stop <= length(groups) && groups[stop] == 0
            stop += 1
        end
        if stop-index > best_length
            best_start,best_length = index,stop-index
        end
        index = stop
    end
    texts = [string(group,base=16) for group in groups]
    best_start == 0 && return join(texts,':')
    join(texts[1:(best_start-1)],':')*"::"*join(texts[(best_start+best_length):end],':')
end
function dns_rdata(message,type,start,size)
    type == 1 && return (ipv4_notation(dns_integer(message,start,4)),start+4)
    type == 28 && return (ipv6_notation(dns_chunk(message,start,16)),start+16)
    type in (2,5,12) && return dns_name(message,start)
    if type == 15
        preference = dns_integer(message,start,2)
        exchange,stop = dns_name(message,start+2)
        return "$preference $exchange",stop
    elseif type == 6
        primary,position = dns_name(message,start)
        mailbox,position = dns_name(message,position)
        parts = [primary,mailbox]
        for _ in 1:5
            push!(parts,string(dns_integer(message,position,4)))
            position += 4
        end
        return join(parts,' '),position
    end
    "$size bytes",start+size
end
function dns_record!(message,position,section,layer)
    name,position = dns_name(message,position)
    fixed = dns_chunk(message,position,10)
    type,class,ttl,size = read_integer(fixed,0,2),read_integer(fixed,2,2),read_integer(
        fixed,
        4,
        4
    ),read_integer(
        fixed,
        8,
        2
    )
    start = position+10
    start+size > length(message) && throw(Malformed("dns: truncated"))
    data,stop = dns_rdata(message,type,start,size)
    stop != start+size && throw(Malformed("dns: bad rdata length"))
    add_field!(layer,section,"$name $(type_name(type)) $(class_name(class)) $ttl $data")
    section == "dns.answer" && type == 1 && add_field!(layer,"dns.a",read_integer(message,start,4))
    start+size
end
function dissect_dns(message)
    header = dns_chunk(message,0,12)
    flags = read_integer(header,2,2)
    counts = [read_integer(header,i,2) for i in 4:2:10]
    layer = Layer()
    set_field!(layer,"dns.id",read_integer(header,0,2))
    set_field!(layer,"dns.flags",flags)
    set_field!(layer,"dns.flags.response",flags÷32768%2)
    set_field!(layer,"dns.flags.opcode",flags÷2048%16)
    set_field!(layer,"dns.flags.rcode",flags%16)
    for (name,count) in zip(
        ("dns.count.queries","dns.count.answers","dns.count.auth_rr","dns.count.add_rr"),
        counts
    )
        set_field!(layer,name,count)
    end
    position = 12
    for _ in 1:counts[1]
        name,position = dns_name(message,position)
        tail = dns_chunk(message,position,4)
        add_field!(layer,"dns.qry.name",name)
        add_field!(layer,"dns.qry.type",read_integer(tail,0,2))
        position += 4
    end
    for (section,count) in zip(("dns.answer","dns.authority","dns.additional"),counts[2:end])
        for _ in 1:count
            position = dns_record!(message,position,section,layer)
        end
    end
    layer
end

const SEQUENCE_MODULUS = 4294967296
const MARKS = ("retransmission", "out_of_order", "lost_segment", "duplicate_ack")
const Endpoint = Tuple{Int,Int}

Base.@kwdef mutable struct PreviousAck
    ack::Int
    window::Int
    number::Int
    count::Int = 0
end
Base.@kwdef mutable struct FlowSide
    name::String
    isn::Union{Nothing,Int} = nothing
    mss::Union{Nothing,Int} = nothing
    wscale::Union{Nothing,Int} = nothing
    base::Union{Nothing,Int} = nothing
    expected::Union{Nothing,Int} = nothing
    advanced_at::Union{Nothing,Int} = nothing
    intervals::Set{Tuple{Int,Int}} = Set{Tuple{Int,Int}}()
    previous_ack::Union{Nothing,PreviousAck} = nothing
    packets::Int = 0
    payload::Int = 0
    marks::Dict{String,Int} = Dict(mark=>0 for mark in MARKS)
end
Base.@kwdef mutable struct Stream
    number::Int
    client::Endpoint
    server::Endpoint
    state::String
    history::Vector{Tuple{String,Int}}
    start_time::Int
    end_time::Int
    packets::Int = 0
    bytes::Int = 0
    syn::Union{Nothing,Int} = nothing
    syn_ack::Union{Nothing,Int} = nothing
    handshake_ack::Union{Nothing,Int} = nothing
    events::Vector{Tuple{Int,String,String,Int,Int}} = Tuple{Int,String,String,Int,Int}[]
    closer::String = ""
    final_ack::Union{Nothing,Int} = nothing
    client_side::FlowSide = FlowSide(name="client")
    server_side::FlowSide = FlowSide(name="server")
end
Base.@kwdef mutable struct StreamTracker
    streams::Vector{Stream} = Stream[]
    latest::Dict{Tuple{Endpoint,Endpoint},Stream} = Dict{Tuple{Endpoint,Endpoint},Stream}()
    duplicate_acks::Dict{Int,Tuple{Int,Int}} = Dict{Int,Tuple{Int,Int}}()
end
endpoint_pair(first,second) = first <= second ? (first,second) : (second,first)
function make_segment(packet)
    value(name) = packet_value(packet,name)
    (
        packet=packet,
        number=packet.number,
        time=packet.time,
        source=(value("ip.src"),value("tcp.srcport")),
        destination=(value("ip.dst"),value("tcp.dstport")),
        seq=value("tcp.seq_raw"),
        ack=value("tcp.ack_raw"),
        fin=value("tcp.flags.fin"),
        syn=value("tcp.flags.syn"),
        rst=value("tcp.flags.rst"),
        has_ack=value("tcp.flags.ack"),
        window=value("tcp.window"),
        length=value("tcp.len")
    )
end
syn_only(segment) = segment.syn == 1 && segment.has_ack == 0
syn_ack(segment) = segment.syn == 1 && segment.has_ack == 1
function change_state!(stream,state,number)
    stream.state = state
    push!(stream.history,(state,number))
end
function record_syn!(stream,side,segment)
    side.isn = segment.seq
    side.mss = packet_value(segment.packet,"tcp.options.mss")
    side.wscale = packet_value(segment.packet,"tcp.options.wscale")
    if side.name == "client"
        stream.syn = segment.number
    else
        stream.syn_ack = segment.number
    end
end
function open_stream!(tracker,segment)
    if syn_ack(segment)
        client,server,state = segment.destination,segment.source,"SYN_RECEIVED"
    else
        client,server = segment.source,segment.destination
        state = syn_only(segment) ? "SYN_SENT" : "ESTABLISHED"
    end
    stream = Stream(
        number=length(tracker.streams),
        client=client,
        server=server,
        state=state,
        history=[(state,segment.number)],
        start_time=segment.time,
        end_time=segment.time
    )
    if syn_ack(segment)
        record_syn!(stream,stream.server_side,segment)
    elseif syn_only(segment)
        record_syn!(stream,stream.client_side,segment)
    end
    push!(tracker.streams,stream)
    stream
end
function sequence_mark(side,start,size,time)
    (isnothing(side.expected) || start == side.expected) && return nothing
    start > side.expected && return "lost_segment"
    (start,size) in side.intervals && return "retransmission"
    time-side.advanced_at < 3000 ? "out_of_order" : "retransmission"
end
function analyze_segment!(tracker,stream,side,segment,start)
    size = segment.length+segment.syn+segment.fin
    mark = nothing
    if size >= 1
        mark = sequence_mark(side,start,size,segment.time)
        push!(side.intervals,(start,size))
        if isnothing(side.expected) || start+size > side.expected
            side.expected,side.advanced_at = start+size,segment.time
        end
    elseif segment.has_ack == 1 && segment.rst == 0
        previous = side.previous_ack
        if !isnothing(previous) && segment.ack == previous.ack && segment.window == previous.window
            mark = "duplicate_ack"
            previous.count += 1
            tracker.duplicate_acks[segment.number] = (previous.number,previous.count)
        end
    end
    if segment.has_ack == 1 && mark != "duplicate_ack"
        side.previous_ack = PreviousAck(ack=segment.ack,window=segment.window,number=segment.number)
    end
    if !isnothing(mark)
        set_field!(segment.packet,"tcp.analysis."*mark,true)
        side.marks[mark] += 1
        push!(stream.events,(segment.number,side.name,mark,start,size))
    end
end
function transition!(stream,side,segment)
    state,number = stream.state,segment.number
    if segment.rst == 1
        !(state in ("CLOSED","RESET")) && change_state!(stream,"RESET",number)
    elseif state == "SYN_SENT" && syn_ack(segment) && side.name == "server" && segment.ack == mod(
        stream.client_side.isn+1,
        SEQUENCE_MODULUS
    )
        change_state!(stream,"SYN_RECEIVED",number)
        record_syn!(stream,stream.server_side,segment)
    elseif state == "SYN_RECEIVED" && side.name == "client" && segment.has_ack == 1 && segment.syn == 0 && segment.ack == mod(
        stream.server_side.isn+1,
        SEQUENCE_MODULUS
    )
        change_state!(stream,"ESTABLISHED",number)
        stream.handshake_ack = number
    elseif state == "ESTABLISHED" && segment.fin == 1
        change_state!(stream,"FIN_WAIT",number)
        stream.closer = side.name
    elseif state == "FIN_WAIT" && segment.fin == 1 && side.name != stream.closer
        change_state!(stream,"CLOSING",number)
        stream.final_ack = mod(segment.seq+segment.length+1,SEQUENCE_MODULUS)
    elseif state == "CLOSING" && side.name == stream.closer && segment.has_ack == 1 && segment.ack == stream.final_ack
        change_state!(stream,"CLOSED",number)
    end
end
function track!(tracker,packet)
    segment = make_segment(packet)
    key = endpoint_pair(segment.source,segment.destination)
    stream = get(tracker.latest,key,nothing)
    if isnothing(stream) || (stream.state in ("CLOSED","RESET") && syn_only(segment))
        stream = open_stream!(tracker,segment)
        tracker.latest[key] = stream
    end
    set_field!(packet,"tcp.stream",stream.number)
    side,other = segment.source == stream.client ? (stream.client_side,stream.server_side) : (
        stream.server_side,
        stream.client_side
    )
    isnothing(side.base) && (side.base=segment.seq)
    segment.has_ack == 1 && isnothing(other.base) && (other.base=segment.ack)
    relative_seq = mod(segment.seq-side.base,SEQUENCE_MODULUS)
    set_field!(packet,"tcp.seq",relative_seq)
    segment.has_ack == 1 && set_field!(packet,"tcp.ack",mod(segment.ack-other.base,SEQUENCE_MODULUS))
    analyze_segment!(tracker,stream,side,segment,relative_seq)
    scaled = !isnothing(stream.client_side.wscale) && !isnothing(stream.server_side.wscale)
    window = scaled && segment.syn == 0 ? segment.window*(1 << side.wscale) : segment.window
    set_field!(packet,"tcp.window.calc",window)
    transition!(stream,side,segment)
    side.packets += 1
    side.payload += segment.length
    stream.packets += 1
    stream.bytes += packet.length
    stream.end_time = segment.time
end
Base.@kwdef mutable struct Conversation
    kind::String
    endpoint_a::Endpoint
    endpoint_b::Endpoint
    first_number::Int
    first_time::Int
    last_time::Int
    packets_a_to_b::Int = 0
    bytes_a_to_b::Int = 0
    packets_b_to_a::Int = 0
    bytes_b_to_a::Int = 0
end
flow_packets(c) = c.packets_a_to_b+c.packets_b_to_a
flow_bytes(c) = c.bytes_a_to_b+c.bytes_b_to_a
function conversation_views(packet)
    source_ip,destination_ip = packet_value(packet,"ip.src"),packet_value(packet,"ip.dst")
    views = NamedTuple[(
        kind="ipv4",
        key=endpoint_pair(source_ip,destination_ip),
        source=(source_ip,-1),
        destination=(destination_ip,-1)
    )]
    if field_exists(packet,"tcp.stream")
        source,destination = (source_ip,packet_value(packet,"tcp.srcport")),(
            destination_ip,
            packet_value(packet,"tcp.dstport")
        )
        push!(views,(kind="tcp",key=packet_value(packet,"tcp.stream"),source=source,destination=destination))
    end
    if field_exists(packet,"udp.srcport")
        source,destination = (source_ip,packet_value(packet,"udp.srcport")),(
            destination_ip,
            packet_value(packet,"udp.dstport")
        )
        push!(views,(kind="udp",key=endpoint_pair(source,destination),source=source,destination=destination))
    end
    views
end
function build_conversations(packets)
    table = Dict{Any,Conversation}()
    conversations = Conversation[]
    for packet in packets
        field_exists(packet,"ip.src") || continue
        for view in conversation_views(packet)
            key = (view.kind,view.key)
            if !haskey(table,key)
                conversation = Conversation(
                    kind=view.kind,
                    endpoint_a=view.source,
                    endpoint_b=view.destination,
                    first_number=packet.number,
                    first_time=packet.time,
                    last_time=packet.time
                )
                table[key] = conversation
                push!(conversations,conversation)
            end
            conversation = table[key]
            if view.source == conversation.endpoint_a
                conversation.packets_a_to_b += 1
                conversation.bytes_a_to_b += packet.length
            else
                conversation.packets_b_to_a += 1
                conversation.bytes_b_to_a += packet.length
            end
            conversation.last_time = packet.time
        end
    end
    kinds = ("ipv4","tcp","udp")
    sort!(conversations,by=c->(-flow_bytes(c),-flow_packets(c),findfirst(==(c.kind),kinds),c.first_number))
end
Base.@kwdef mutable struct NetworkEndpoint
    address::Int
    tx_packets::Int = 0
    tx_bytes::Int = 0
    rx_packets::Int = 0
    rx_bytes::Int = 0
end
endpoint_packets(e) = e.tx_packets+e.rx_packets
endpoint_bytes(e) = e.tx_bytes+e.rx_bytes
function build_endpoints(packets)
    table = Dict{Int,NetworkEndpoint}()
    for packet in packets
        field_exists(packet,"ip.src") || continue
        source,destination = packet_value(packet,"ip.src"),packet_value(packet,"ip.dst")
        sender = get!(()->NetworkEndpoint(address=source),table,source)
        sender.tx_packets += 1
        sender.tx_bytes += packet.length
        receiver = get!(()->NetworkEndpoint(address=destination),table,destination)
        receiver.rx_packets += 1
        receiver.rx_bytes += packet.length
    end
    sort(collect(values(table)),by=e->(-endpoint_bytes(e),-endpoint_packets(e),e.address))
end

mutable struct Packet
    number::Int
    time::Int
    length::Int
    data::Vector{UInt8}
    error::Union{Nothing,String}
    layers::Vector{String}
    fields::Dict{String,Vector{Any}}
    remaining::Vector{UInt8}
end
Packet(n,t,length) = Packet(n,t,length,UInt8[],nothing,String[],Dict{String,Vector{Any}}(),UInt8[])
field_values(packet,name) = get(packet.fields,name,Any[])
packet_value(packet,name) = (values=field_values(packet,name); isempty(values) ? nothing : values[1])
field_exists(packet,name) = haskey(packet.fields,name)
set_field!(object,name,value) = (object.fields[name]=Any[value])
add_field!(object,name,value) = push!(get!(()->Any[],object.fields,name),value)
function read_capture(path)
    packets = Packet[]
    lines_by_packet = Vector{Tuple{Int,String}}[]
    for (number,line) in enumerate(readlines(path))
        if startswith(line,"PACKET ")
            fields = split(line)
            push!(packets,Packet(parse.(Int,fields[2:4])...))
            push!(lines_by_packet,Tuple{Int,String}[])
        elseif !isempty(line)
            push!(lines_by_packet[end],(number,line))
        end
    end
    for (packet,lines) in zip(packets,lines_by_packet)
        data = UInt8[]
        for (number,line) in lines
            if !occursin(r"^[0-9a-f]{4}  [0-9a-f]{2}(?: [0-9a-f]{2}){0,15}$",line)
                packet.error = "dump: bad line $number"
                break
            elseif parse(Int,line[1:4],base=16) != length(data)
                packet.error = "dump: offset mismatch at line $number"
                break
            end
            append!(data,[parse(UInt8,byte,base=16) for byte in split(line[7:end])])
        end
        if isnothing(packet.error)
            if length(data) != packet.length
                packet.error = "dump: length mismatch (header $(packet.length), data $(length(data)))"
            else
                packet.data = data
            end
        end
    end
    packets
end
function hex_dump_lines(data)
    lines = String[]
    for offset in 0:16:(length(data)-1)
        piece = data[(offset+1):min(offset+16,length(data))]
        hex = join((string(byte,base=16,pad=2) for byte in piece),' ')
        text = String([32 <= byte <= 126 ? Char(byte) : '.' for byte in piece])
        push!(lines,"$(string(offset,base=16,pad=4))  $(rpad(hex,47))  |$text|")
    end
    lines
end

struct Malformed <: Exception
    reason::String
end
Base.showerror(io::IO,error::Malformed) = print(io,error.reason)
mutable struct Layer
    fields::Dict{String,Vector{Any}}
    next_layer::Union{Nothing,String}
    payload::Vector{UInt8}
    remaining::Vector{UInt8}
end
Layer() = Layer(Dict{String,Vector{Any}}(),nothing,UInt8[],UInt8[])
function read_integer(data,index,count)
    value = 0
    for i in (index+1):(index+count)
        value = value*256+Int(data[i])
    end
    value
end
integer_bytes(value,count) = [UInt8((value >> (8*i)) & 255) for i in (count-1):-1:0]
function checksum_status(data)
    total = 0
    for i in 1:2:length(data)
        total += Int(data[i])*256+(i < length(data) ? Int(data[i+1]) : 0)
    end
    while total > 65535
        total = total%65536+total÷65536
    end
    total == 65535 ? "good" : "bad"
end
mac_notation(value) = join((string(byte,base=16,pad=2) for byte in integer_bytes(value,6)),':')
ipv4_notation(value) = join(Int.(integer_bytes(value,4)),'.')
function forward!(layer,name,payload)
    layer.next_layer,layer.payload = name,payload
end
function dissect_ethernet(frame)
    length(frame) < 14 && throw(Malformed("eth: truncated"))
    layer = Layer()
    type = read_integer(frame,12,2)
    set_field!(layer,"eth.dst",read_integer(frame,0,6))
    set_field!(layer,"eth.src",read_integer(frame,6,6))
    set_field!(layer,"eth.type",type)
    payload = frame[15:end]
    if type in (2054,2048)
        forward!(layer,type == 2054 ? "arp" : "ip",payload)
    else
        layer.remaining = payload
    end
    layer
end
function dissect_arp(message)
    length(message) < 28 && throw(Malformed("arp: truncated"))
    if read_integer(message,0,2) != 1 || read_integer(
        message,
        2,
        2
    ) != 2048 || message[5] != 6 || message[6] != 4
        throw(Malformed("arp: unsupported format"))
    end
    layer = Layer()
    for (name,start,count) in (
        ("arp.opcode",6,2),
        ("arp.src.hw",8,6),
        ("arp.src.ip",14,4),
        ("arp.dst.hw",18,6),
        ("arp.dst.ip",24,4)
    )
        set_field!(layer,name,read_integer(message,start,count))
    end
    layer
end
function dissect_ipv4(datagram)
    available = length(datagram)
    available < 20 && throw(Malformed("ip: truncated header"))
    version = Int(datagram[1])÷16
    version != 4 && throw(Malformed("ip: bad version $version"))
    header = Int(datagram[1])%16*4
    header < 20 && throw(Malformed("ip: bad header length $header"))
    available < header && throw(Malformed("ip: truncated header"))
    total = read_integer(datagram,2,2)
    total < header && throw(Malformed("ip: bad total length $total"))
    total > available && throw(Malformed("ip: truncated (total length $total, available $available)"))
    flags = read_integer(datagram,6,2)
    more,offset = flags÷8192%2,flags%8192*8
    protocol = Int(datagram[10])
    layer = Layer()
    entries = (
        ("ip.hdr_len",header),
        ("ip.tos",Int(datagram[2])),
        ("ip.len",total),
        ("ip.id",read_integer(datagram,4,2)),
        ("ip.flags.df",flags÷16384%2),
        ("ip.flags.mf",more),
        ("ip.frag_offset",offset),
        ("ip.ttl",Int(datagram[9])),
        ("ip.proto",protocol),
        ("ip.checksum",read_integer(datagram,10,2)),
        ("ip.checksum.status",checksum_status(datagram[1:header])),
        ("ip.src",read_integer(datagram,12,4)),
        ("ip.dst",read_integer(datagram,16,4))
    )
    for (name,value) in entries
        set_field!(layer,name,value)
    end
    payload = datagram[(header+1):total]
    if more == 1 || offset != 0
        set_field!(layer,"ip.fragment",true)
        layer.remaining = payload
    elseif protocol in (1,17,6)
        forward!(layer,protocol == 1 ? "icmp" : protocol == 17 ? "udp" : "tcp",payload)
    else
        layer.remaining = payload
    end
    layer
end

const FIELDS = (
    ("frame.number","integer"),
    ("frame.time","integer"),
    ("frame.len","integer"),
    ("frame.protocols","string"),
    ("frame.malformed","string"),
    ("frame.bad_checksum","presence"),
    ("eth.dst","mac"),
    ("eth.src","mac"),
    ("eth.type","hex4"),
    ("arp.opcode","integer"),
    ("arp.src.hw","mac"),
    ("arp.src.ip","ipv4"),
    ("arp.dst.hw","mac"),
    ("arp.dst.ip","ipv4"),

const ALIASES = Dict(
    "eth.addr"=>("mac","eth.dst","eth.src"),
    "ip.addr"=>("ipv4","ip.src","ip.dst"),
    "udp.port"=>("integer","udp.srcport","udp.dstport"),
    "tcp.port"=>("integer","tcp.srcport","tcp.dstport")
)
const PROTOCOL_FIELDS = ("eth","arp","ip","icmp","udp","tcp","dns","data")
const PROTOCOL_LABELS = Dict(
    "eth"=>"ETH",
    "arp"=>"ARP",
    "ip"=>"IPv4",
    "icmp"=>"ICMP",
    "udp"=>"UDP",
    "tcp"=>"TCP",
    "dns"=>"DNS"
)
const CHECKSUM_LAYERS = (("ip","IPv4"),("icmp","ICMP"),("udp","UDP"),("tcp","TCP"))
const FLAG_NAMES = ("FIN","SYN","RST","PSH","ACK","URG","ECE","CWR")
const MARK_LABELS = Dict(
    "retransmission"=>"[TCP Retransmission] ",
    "out_of_order"=>"[TCP Out-Of-Order] ",
    "lost_segment"=>"[TCP Previous segment not captured] "
)
const HIERARCHY = (("eth",0),("arp",2),("ip",2),("icmp",4),("udp",4),("dns",6),("tcp",4))
const CONVERSATION_HEADER = "type,endpoint_a,endpoint_b,packets,bytes,packets_a_to_b,bytes_a_to_b,packets_b_to_a,bytes_b_to_a,start,duration"
const ENDPOINT_HEADER = "address,packets,bytes,tx_packets,tx_bytes,rx_packets,rx_bytes"
const FIELD_TYPES = Dict(FIELDS)

seconds(value) = "$(value÷1000000).$(lpad(value%1000000,6,'0'))"
optional(value) = isnothing(value) ? "-" : string(value)
function notation(type,value)
    type == "hex2" && return "0x"*string(value,base=16,pad=2)
    type == "hex4" && return "0x"*string(value,base=16,pad=4)
    type == "ipv4" && return ipv4_notation(value)
    type == "mac" && return mac_notation(value)
    string(value)
end
shown(packet,name) = notation(FIELD_TYPES[name],packet_value(packet,name))
endpoint_text(endpoint) = ipv4_notation(endpoint[1])*(endpoint[2] == -1 ? "" : ":$(endpoint[2])")
function field_type_of(name)
    haskey(FIELD_TYPES,name) && return FIELD_TYPES[name]
    haskey(ALIASES,name) && return ALIASES[name][1]
    name in PROTOCOL_FIELDS ? "presence" : nothing
end
function filter_field_values(packet,name)
    if haskey(ALIASES,name)
        _,first,second = ALIASES[name]
        return vcat(field_values(packet,first),field_values(packet,second))
    end
    field_values(packet,name)
end
function dissect_layer(packet,name,payload)
    name == "eth" && return dissect_ethernet(payload)
    name == "arp" && return dissect_arp(payload)
    name == "ip" && return dissect_ipv4(payload)
    name == "icmp" && return dissect_icmp(payload)
    name == "udp" && return dissect_udp(payload,packet_value(packet,"ip.src"),packet_value(packet,"ip.dst"))
    name == "tcp" && return dissect_tcp(payload,packet_value(packet,"ip.src"),packet_value(packet,"ip.dst"))
    dissect_dns(payload)
end
function dissect_layers!(packet)
    name,payload = "eth",packet.data
    while true
        push!(packet.layers,name)
        layer = try
            dissect_layer(packet,name,payload)
        catch error
            error isa Malformed || rethrow()
            return error.reason
        end
        merge!(packet.fields,layer.fields)
        if isnothing(layer.next_layer)
            packet.remaining = layer.remaining
            return nothing
        end
        name,payload = layer.next_layer,layer.payload
    end
end
function dissect!(packet,base_time)
    reason = isnothing(packet.error) ? dissect_layers!(packet) : packet.error
    if isnothing(reason) && !isempty(packet.remaining)
        push!(packet.layers,"data")
        set_field!(packet,"data.len",length(packet.remaining))
    end
    set_field!(packet,"frame.number",packet.number)
    set_field!(packet,"frame.time",packet.time-base_time)
    set_field!(packet,"frame.len",packet.length)
    !isempty(packet.layers) && set_field!(packet,"frame.protocols",join(packet.layers,':'))
    !isnothing(reason) && set_field!(packet,"frame.malformed",reason)
    if any(packet_value(packet,layer*".checksum.status") == "bad" for (layer,_) in CHECKSUM_LAYERS)
        set_field!(packet,"frame.bad_checksum",true)
    end
end
function addresses(packet)
    field_exists(packet,"ip.src") && return shown(packet,"ip.src"),shown(packet,"ip.dst")
    field_exists(packet,"eth.src") && return shown(packet,"eth.src"),shown(packet,"eth.dst")
    "-","-"
end
function protocol_label(packet)
    layers = filter(!=("data"),packet.layers)
    isempty(layers) ? "DUMP" : PROTOCOL_LABELS[last(layers)]
end
function option_summary(options)
    parts = String[]
    for option in options
        words = split(option)
        if words[1] == "MSS"
            push!(parts," MSS=$(words[2])")
        elseif words[1] == "WS"
            push!(parts," WS=$(1 << parse(Int,words[2]))")
        elseif words[1] == "SACK_PERM"
            push!(parts," SACK_PERM")
        elseif words[1] == "TS"
            push!(parts," TSval=$(words[2]) TSecr=$(words[3])")
        end
    end
    join(parts)
end
function tcp_info(packet,duplicate_acks)
    prefix = ""
    if field_exists(packet,"tcp.analysis.duplicate_ack")
        original,count = duplicate_acks[packet.number]
        prefix = "[TCP Dup ACK $original#$count] "
    else
        for mark in MARKS[1:3]
            if field_exists(packet,"tcp.analysis."*mark)
                prefix = MARK_LABELS[mark]
                break
            end
        end
    end
    flags = packet_value(packet,"tcp.flags")
    names = [name for (bit,name) in enumerate(FLAG_NAMES) if (flags >> (bit-1)) & 1 == 1]
    flagtext = isempty(names) ? "<None>" : join(names,", ")
    text = prefix*"$(packet_value(packet,"tcp.srcport")) -> $(packet_value(packet,"tcp.dstport")) [$flagtext] Seq=$(packet_value(packet,"tcp.seq"))"
    packet_value(packet,"tcp.flags.ack") == 1 && (text *= " Ack=$(packet_value(packet,"tcp.ack"))")
    text*" Win=$(packet_value(packet,"tcp.window.calc")) Len=$(packet_value(packet,"tcp.len"))"*option_summary(field_values(
        packet,
        "tcp.option"
    ))
end
function dns_info(packet)
    parts = [packet_value(packet,"dns.flags.response") == 1 ? "Response" : "Query",shown(packet,"dns.id")]
    rcode = packet_value(packet,"dns.flags.rcode")
    rcode != 0 && push!(parts,rcode_name(rcode))
    for (name,type) in zip(field_values(packet,"dns.qry.name"),field_values(packet,"dns.qry.type"))
        append!(parts,[type_name(type),name])
    end
    for record in field_values(packet,"dns.answer")
        words = split(record,' ';limit=5)
        append!(parts,[words[2],words[5]])
    end
    join(parts,' ')
end
function basic_info(packet,protocol,duplicate_acks)
    value(name) = packet_value(packet,name)
    field_exists(packet,"frame.malformed") && return value("frame.malformed")
    protocol == "ETH" && return "EtherType "*shown(packet,"eth.type")
    if protocol == "ARP"
        opcode = value("arp.opcode")
        opcode == 1 && return "Who has $(shown(packet,"arp.dst.ip"))? Tell $(shown(packet,"arp.src.ip"))"
        opcode == 2 && return "$(shown(packet,"arp.src.ip")) is at $(shown(packet,"arp.src.hw"))"
        return "Opcode $opcode"
    elseif protocol == "IPv4"
        !field_exists(packet,"ip.fragment") && return "Protocol $(value("ip.proto"))"
        return "Fragment id=$(shown(packet,"ip.id")) off=$(value("ip.frag_offset"))"*(value("ip.flags.mf") == 1 ? " MF" : "")
    elseif protocol == "ICMP"
        type = value("icmp.type")
        type in (
            0,
            8
        ) && return "Echo $(type == 8 ? "request" : "reply") id=$(value("icmp.id")) seq=$(value("icmp.seq"))"
        return "Type $type code $(value("icmp.code"))"
    elseif protocol == "UDP"
        return "$(value("udp.srcport")) -> $(value("udp.dstport")) Len=$(value("udp.length")-8)"
    elseif protocol == "TCP"
        return tcp_info(packet,duplicate_acks)
    end
    dns_info(packet)
end
function summary_line(packet,duplicate_acks)
    source,destination = addresses(packet)
    protocol = protocol_label(packet)
    info = basic_info(packet,protocol,duplicate_acks)
    field_exists(packet,"tcp.options.malformed") && (info *= " [bad TCP options]")
    for (layer,label) in CHECKSUM_LAYERS
        packet_value(packet,layer*".checksum.status") == "bad" && (info *= " [bad $label checksum]")
    end
    "$(packet.number) $(seconds(packet_value(packet,"frame.time"))) $source -> $destination $protocol $(packet.length) $info"
end
struct FilterError <: Exception
    reason::String
end
Base.showerror(io::IO,error::FilterError) = print(io,error.reason)
struct Token
    kind::String
    text::String
    column::Int
end
Base.@kwdef mutable struct FilterNode
    kind::String
    left::Union{Nothing,FilterNode} = nothing
    right::Union{Nothing,FilterNode} = nothing
    field::String = ""
    operator::String = ""
    value::Any = nothing
end
function tokenize(expression)
    tokens = Token[]
    index = 1
    wordchar(c) = 'a' <= c <= 'z' || 'A' <= c <= 'Z' || '0' <= c <= '9' || c in "._:"
    while index <= length(expression)
        character = expression[index]
        pair = expression[index:min(index+1,length(expression))]
        if character == ' '
            index += 1
        elseif pair in ("==","!=","<=",">=","&&","||")
            push!(tokens,Token(pair,pair,index))
            index += 2
        elseif character in "()!<>"
            push!(tokens,Token(string(character),string(character),index))
            index += 1
        elseif character == '"'
            closing = findnext('"',expression,index+1)
            isnothing(closing) && throw(FilterError("unterminated string at column $index"))
            push!(tokens,Token("string",expression[index:closing],index))
            index = closing+1
        elseif wordchar(character)
            after = index
            while after <= length(expression) && wordchar(expression[after])
                after += 1
            end
            word = expression[index:after-1]
            kind = get(Dict("and"=>"&&","or"=>"||","not"=>"!"),word,"word")
            push!(tokens,Token(kind,word,index))
            index = after
        else
            throw(FilterError("invalid character '$character' at column $index"))
        end
    end
    tokens
end
function parse_filter_value(type,token)
    type == "string" && return token.kind == "string" ? token.text[2:end-1] : nothing
    token.kind != "word" && return nothing
    text = token.text
    if type in ("integer","hex2","hex4")
        occursin(r"^[0-9]{1,15}$",text) && return parse(Int,text)
        occursin(r"^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{1,12}$",text) && return parse(Int,text[3:end],base=16)
    else
        parts = split(text,type == "ipv4" ? '.' : ':';keepempty=true)
        length(parts) != (type == "ipv4" ? 4 : 6) && return nothing
        value = 0
        for part in parts
            if type == "ipv4"
                occursin(r"^[0-9]{1,3}$",part) || return nothing
                octet = parse(Int,part)
                octet > 255 && return nothing
            else
                occursin(r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{2}$",part) || return nothing
                octet = parse(Int,part,base=16)
            end
            value = value*256+octet
        end
        return value
    end
    nothing
end
mutable struct FilterParser
    tokens::Vector{Token}
    position::Int
end
next_kind(parser) = parser.position <= length(parser.tokens) ? parser.tokens[parser.position].kind : nothing
unexpected(token) = FilterError("unexpected '$(token.text)' at column $(token.column)")
function take!(parser)
    parser.position > length(parser.tokens) && throw(FilterError("unexpected end of filter"))
    token = parser.tokens[parser.position]
    parser.position += 1
    token
end
function parse_negation!(parser)
    if next_kind(parser) == "!"
        take!(parser)
        return FilterNode(kind="not",left=parse_negation!(parser))
    end
    token = take!(parser)
    if token.kind == "("
        node = parse_expression!(parser)
        closing = take!(parser)
        closing.kind != ")" && throw(unexpected(closing))
        return node
    end
    token.kind != "word" && throw(unexpected(token))
    name = token.text
    type = field_type_of(name)
    isnothing(type) && throw(FilterError("unknown field $name"))
    !(next_kind(parser) in ("==","!=","<",">","<=",">=")) && return FilterNode(kind="exists",field=name)
    operator = take!(parser).kind
    if type == "presence" || (type == "string" && !(operator in ("==","!=")))
        throw(FilterError("operator $operator not allowed for $name"))
    end
    token = take!(parser)
    !(token.kind in ("word","string")) && throw(unexpected(token))
    value = parse_filter_value(type,token)
    isnothing(value) && throw(FilterError("invalid value $(token.text) for $name"))
    FilterNode(kind="compare",field=name,operator=operator,value=value)
end
function parse_product!(parser)
    node = parse_negation!(parser)
    while next_kind(parser) == "&&"
        take!(parser)
        node = FilterNode(kind="and",left=node,right=parse_negation!(parser))
    end
    node
end
function parse_expression!(parser)
    node = parse_product!(parser)
    while next_kind(parser) == "||"
        take!(parser)
        node = FilterNode(kind="or",left=node,right=parse_product!(parser))
    end
    node
end
function parse_filter(expression)
    parser = FilterParser(tokenize(expression),1)
    node = parse_expression!(parser)
    parser.position <= length(parser.tokens) && throw(unexpected(parser.tokens[parser.position]))
    node
end
function compare_value(left,operator,right)
    operator == "==" && return left == right
    operator == "<" && return left < right
    operator == ">" && return left > right
    operator == "<=" ? left <= right : left >= right
end
function evaluate(node,packet)
    node.kind == "or" && return evaluate(node.left,packet) || evaluate(node.right,packet)
    node.kind == "and" && return evaluate(node.left,packet) && evaluate(node.right,packet)
    node.kind == "not" && return !evaluate(node.left,packet)
    if node.kind == "exists"
        return node.field in PROTOCOL_FIELDS ? node.field in packet.layers : !isempty(filter_field_values(
            packet,
            node.field
        ))
    end
    values = filter_field_values(packet,node.field)
    isempty(values) && return false
    node.operator == "!=" && return all(value != node.value for value in values)
    any(compare_value(value,node.operator,node.value) for value in values)
end
function filter_block(expression,packets,summaries)
    lines = ["","filter $expression"]
    tree = try
        parse_filter(expression)
    catch error
        error isa FilterError || rethrow()
        push!(lines,"error: $(error.reason)")
        return lines
    end
    matched = filter(packet->evaluate(tree,packet),packets)
    append!(lines,[summaries[packet.number] for packet in matched])
    push!(lines,"matched $(length(matched)) of $(length(packets))")
    lines
end
function detail_lines(packets,number)
    !(1 <= number <= length(packets)) && return ["packet $number not found"]
    packet = packets[number]
    lines = ["packet $number"]
    for layer in vcat(["frame"],packet.layers)
        push!(lines,layer)
        for (name,type) in FIELDS
            startswith(name,layer*".") || continue
            for value in field_values(packet,name)
                push!(lines,type == "presence" ? "  $name" : "  $name = $(notation(type,value))")
            end
        end
        layer == "data" && append!(lines,["  "*line for line in hex_dump_lines(packet.remaining)])
    end
    lines
end
function dns_transactions(packets)
    queries,responses,pending = Packet[],Packet[],Packet[]
    times = Int[]
    for packet in packets
        field_exists(packet,"dns.id") || continue
        if packet_value(packet,"dns.flags.response") == 0
            push!(queries,packet)
            push!(pending,packet)
        else
            push!(responses,packet)
            index = findfirst(pending) do query
                packet_value(query,"dns.id") == packet_value(packet,"dns.id") &&
                all(packet_value(query,a) == packet_value(packet,b) for (a,b) in (
                    ("ip.src","ip.dst"),
                    ("udp.srcport","udp.dstport"),
                    ("ip.dst","ip.src"),
                    ("udp.dstport","udp.srcport")
                ))
            end
            if !isnothing(index)
                push!(times,packet.time-pending[index].time)
                deleteat!(pending,index)
            end
        end
    end
    (queries=queries,responses=responses,times=times,unanswered=length(pending))
end
function protocol_stats_lines(packets,transactions)
    lines = [
        "packets $(length(packets))",
        "bytes $(sum(packet.length for packet in packets))",
        "duration $(seconds(packets[end].time-packets[1].time))",
        "hierarchy"
    ]
    for (name,indent) in HIERARCHY
        members = filter(packet->name in packet.layers,packets)
        push!(
            lines,
            "$(repeat(" ",indent))$name $(length(members)) $(sum(packet.length for packet in members;init=0))"
        )
    end
    push!(lines,"checksums")
    for (layer,_) in CHECKSUM_LAYERS
        statuses = [packet_value(packet,layer*".checksum.status") for packet in packets]
        text = "$layer good $(count(==("good"),statuses)) bad $(count(==("bad"),statuses))"
        layer == "udp" && (text *= " none $(count(==("none"),statuses))")
        push!(lines,text)
    end
    append!(lines,["malformed","dump $(count(packet->!isnothing(packet.error),packets))"])
    for name in PROTOCOL_FIELDS[1:7]
        total = count(
            packet->isnothing(packet.error) && field_exists(
                packet,
                "frame.malformed"
            ) && last(packet.layers) == name,
            packets
        )
        push!(lines,"$name $total")
    end
    push!(lines,"tcp analysis")
    for mark in MARKS
        push!(lines,"$mark $(count(packet->field_exists(packet,"tcp.analysis."*mark),packets))")
    end
    append!(
        lines,
        [
            "dns",
            "queries $(length(transactions.queries))",
            "responses $(length(transactions.responses))",
            "transactions $(length(transactions.times))",
            "unanswered $(transactions.unanswered)"
        ]
    )
    times = transactions.times
    push!(
        lines,
        isempty(times) ? "response_time -" : "response_time min $(seconds(minimum(times))) max $(seconds(maximum(times)))"
    )
    for rcode in 0:15
        total = count(packet->packet_value(packet,"dns.flags.rcode") == rcode,transactions.responses)
        total > 0 && push!(lines,"rcode $(rcode_name(rcode)) $total")
    end
    push!(lines,"names")
    counts = Dict{String,Int}()
    for query in transactions.queries, name in field_values(query,"dns.qry.name")
        counts[name] = get(counts,name,0)+1
    end
    for name in sort(collect(keys(counts)),by=name->(-counts[name],name))
        push!(lines,"$name $(counts[name])")
    end
    lines
end
function conversation_lines(conversations,base_time)

end

function stream_lines(stream,packets)
    client,server = stream.client_side,stream.server_side

    lines = [
        "stream $(stream.number) $(endpoint_text(stream.client)) -> $(endpoint_text(stream.server))",

        "options client mss $(optional(client.mss)) wscale $(optional(client.wscale)) server mss $(optional(server.mss)) wscale $(optional(server.wscale))",
        side_line(client),side_line(server)

        push!(lines,"event $number $side $mark seq $start len $size")
    end
    lines
end
function joined_blocks(blocks)

    lines

function main()
    packets = read_capture(joinpath("input","capture.txt"))
    filters,detail_numbers = String[],Int[]
    for line in readlines(joinpath("input","filters.txt"))
        startswith(line,"FILTER ") && push!(filters,line[8:end])
        startswith(line,"DETAIL ") && push!(detail_numbers,parse(Int,line[8:end]))
    end
    base_time = packets[1].time
    for packet in packets
        dissect!(packet,base_time)
    end
    tracker = StreamTracker()
    for packet in packets
        field_exists(packet,"tcp.srcport") && track!(tracker,packet)
    end
    summaries = [summary_line(packet,tracker.duplicate_acks) for packet in packets]
    summary = copy(summaries)
    for expression in filters
        append!(summary,filter_block(expression,packets,summaries))
    end
    outputs = (
        "summary.txt"=>summary,
        "details.txt"=>joined_blocks(detail_lines(packets,number) for number in detail_numbers),
        "conversations.csv"=>conversation_lines(build_conversations(packets),base_time),
        "endpoints.csv"=>endpoint_lines(build_endpoints(packets)),
        "protocol_stats.txt"=>protocol_stats_lines(packets,dns_transactions(packets)),
        "tcp_streams.txt"=>joined_blocks(stream_lines(stream,packets) for stream in tracker.streams)
    )
    mkpath("output")
    for (name,lines) in outputs
        open(joinpath("output",name),"w") do handle
            foreach(line->println(handle,line),lines)
        end
    end
end
main()

pseudo_header(source,destination,protocol,length) = vcat(
    integer_bytes(source,4),
    integer_bytes(destination,4),
    UInt8[0,protocol],
    integer_bytes(length,2)
)
function dissect_icmp(message)
    length(message) < 8 && throw(Malformed("icmp: truncated"))
    layer = Layer()
    type = Int(message[1])
    set_field!(layer,"icmp.type",type)
    set_field!(layer,"icmp.code",Int(message[2]))
    set_field!(layer,"icmp.checksum",read_integer(message,2,2))
    set_field!(layer,"icmp.checksum.status",checksum_status(message))
    if type in (0,8)
        set_field!(layer,"icmp.id",read_integer(message,4,2))
        set_field!(layer,"icmp.seq",read_integer(message,6,2))
    end
    layer.remaining = message[9:end]
    layer
end
function dissect_udp(datagram,source,destination)
    length(datagram) < 8 && throw(Malformed("udp: truncated"))
    size = read_integer(datagram,4,2)
    (size < 8 || size > length(datagram)) && throw(Malformed("udp: bad length $size"))
    source_port,destination_port = read_integer(datagram,0,2),read_integer(datagram,2,2)
    checksum = read_integer(datagram,6,2)
    status = checksum == 0 ? "none" : checksum_status(vcat(
        pseudo_header(source,destination,17,size),
        datagram[1:size]
    ))
    layer = Layer()
    for (name,value) in (
        ("udp.srcport",source_port),
        ("udp.dstport",destination_port),
        ("udp.length",size),
        ("udp.checksum",checksum),
        ("udp.checksum.status",status)
    )
        set_field!(layer,name,value)
    end
    payload = datagram[9:size]
    if source_port == 53 || destination_port == 53
        forward!(layer,"dns",payload)
    else
        layer.remaining = payload
    end
    layer
end
function option_text(kind,size,body,layer)
    if kind == 2
        mss = read_integer(body,0,2)
        set_field!(layer,"tcp.options.mss",mss)
        return "MSS $mss"
    elseif kind == 3
        scale = Int(body[1])
        set_field!(layer,"tcp.options.wscale",scale)
        return "WS $scale"
    elseif kind == 4
        return "SACK_PERM"
    elseif kind == 5
        return "SACK"*join((" $(read_integer(body,i,4))-$(read_integer(body,i+4,4))" for i in 0:8:(length(body)-1)))
    elseif kind == 8
        return "TS $(read_integer(body,0,4)) $(read_integer(body,4,4))"
    end
    "kind $kind len $size"
end
function parse_options!(options,layer)
    lengths = Dict(2=>(4,),3=>(3,),4=>(2,),5=>(10,18,26,34),8=>(10,))
    index = 1
    while index <= length(options)
        kind = Int(options[index])
        if kind == 0
            add_field!(layer,"tcp.option","EOL")
            return
        elseif kind == 1
            add_field!(layer,"tcp.option","NOP")
            index += 1
            continue
        end
        size = index < length(options) ? Int(options[index+1]) : 0
        if size < 2 || index+size-1 > length(options) || (haskey(lengths,kind) && !(size in lengths[kind]))
            set_field!(layer,"tcp.options.malformed",true)
            return
        end
        body = options[(index+2):(index+size-1)]
        add_field!(layer,"tcp.option",option_text(kind,size,body,layer))
        index += size
    end
end
function dissect_tcp(segment,source,destination)
    length(segment) < 20 && throw(Malformed("tcp: truncated header"))
    header = Int(segment[13])÷16*4
    header < 20 && throw(Malformed("tcp: bad header length $header"))
    header > length(segment) && throw(Malformed("tcp: truncated header"))
    flags = Int(segment[14])
    layer = Layer()
    for (name,start,count) in (
        ("tcp.srcport",0,2),
        ("tcp.dstport",2,2),
        ("tcp.seq_raw",4,4),
        ("tcp.window",14,2),
        ("tcp.checksum",16,2),
        ("tcp.urgent",18,2)
    )
        set_field!(layer,name,read_integer(segment,start,count))
    end
    set_field!(layer,"tcp.hdr_len",header)
    set_field!(layer,"tcp.flags",flags)
    for (bit,name) in enumerate(("fin","syn","rst","psh","ack","urg"))
        set_field!(layer,"tcp.flags."*name,(flags >> (bit-1)) & 1)
    end
    set_field!(
        layer,
        "tcp.checksum.status",
        checksum_status(vcat(pseudo_header(source,destination,6,length(segment)),segment))
    )
    set_field!(layer,"tcp.len",length(segment)-header)
    flags & 16 != 0 && set_field!(layer,"tcp.ack_raw",read_integer(segment,8,4))
    parse_options!(segment[21:header],layer)
    layer.remaining = segment[(header+1):end]
    layer
end
